messages:
noah: Poll time — team lunch showdown. Cheese toast or avo bagel? Reply with two words + a dramatic one-sentence endorsement.
yasmin: Cheese toast — childhood hug. Seriously, melted cheese > everything.
devin: Avo bagel — crunchy serene. Also can confirm pair well with stubborn coffee.
maria: Cheese toast — golden slab. @yasmin you always bring the correct energy :cheese: 
kevin: Avo bagel — toast rebellion. But can we get both pls?
lunchbot: New poll created: Cheese toast vs Avo bagel. Vote with :one: or :two:
noah: Also quick PSA — kitchen shelf labeled "yesterday's experiments" is now officially a museum. Please rescue items.
yasmin: kudos to @kevin for returning the office kettle to its former glory yesterday :tada: 
devin: Two-word: "melted justice". Line: If it drips, it's working.
maria: Two-word: "carb embrace". Line: No regrets, only crumbs.
kevin: Two-word: "green zen". Line: Avo makes spreadsheets look better.
yasmin: Final tally (based on vibes): Cheese toast wins by crumbs. :sparkles: 
maria: tiny addendum — plant-therapy session at 4? bring watering cans. (Also low-key nap optional)
noah: I'm in. Also whoever took the blue mug from desk 7, we will charge you in cookies.
devin: :cookie: :raised_hands:
